description: Read the deterministic SHARED guided-setup state for one job: which operational setup is still missing (operating brief/objective, typed workflow, applicable required operating choices), with canonical evidence, ordered questions, evidence-backed proposed defaults, validated canonical write previews, and the in-progress dedupe view. DRIVEN multi-agent flow, in order: inspect inProgress (if inProgress.complete is false, or an ACTIVE setup.* intent or OPEN setup.* proposal you do not own exists, stand down); ownership requires that intent.sessionId exactly equal this response sync.session.sessionId with matching principalUserId — a visible winner id from DUPLICATE is not adoptable; declare your own setup.* intent via opentrain_declare_job_context_intent (DUPLICATE means stand down); only the same-durable-session winner PRESENTS questions/drafts; immediately before approved writes, re-read setup and prove the session binding still holds; apply only through normal brief/policy operations; then verify, resolve the intent, and hand off. Null/mismatched sessions mean establish durable identity or coordinate with the owner. Record an approved postponement as the component setup-deferral OPERATING_RULE policy. INDETERMINATE is fail-closed nonterminal evidence — follow evidenceRecovery and retry; never prompt from it. Once COMPLETE or DEFERRED, do not re-prompt anyone. Read-only; nothing here executes automatically.
name: opentrain_get_job_setup
